summary: Market Risk Coverage Lead - Vice President candidate with ~7 years across fixed income and multi-asset market risk analytics. Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation and sensitivity outputs for institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement, with hands-on VaR/CVaR portfolio optimization, stress scenario construction, and rates, foreign exchange and inflation derivatives validation. Model governance committee member, presenting scenario impacts and interest-rate exposure to Heads of Risk and investment committees. CFA charterholder; dual MSc.
core_skills: Market Risk Analytics (Fixed Income, Rates & FX)
Market Risk Model Methodology Review & Governance
Python, SQL, Advanced Excel; VBA (working knowledge)

sections.heading: Fixed Income & Multi-Asset Market Risk Analytics
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement ($50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions before production release.
Validated derivatives pricing outputs across rates, foreign exchange (FX), and inflation, confirming consistency of sensitivities and scenario impacts at portfolio-level aggregates.
Oversaw interest-rate risk and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks across multi-asset institutional books.
Reviewed aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics feeding downstream balance-sheet and capital processes.

sections.heading: Model Methodology Review, Governance & Escalation
bullets: Serves on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, benchmarking and documentation standards, and model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.

Escalated outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility and acted as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing directly with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.

sections.heading: Stress Scenarios, Macro Overlays & Senior Reporting
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios across multi-year horizons.
Embedded behavioral cash-flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macroeconomic stress overlays into scenario construction.
Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and portfolio sensitivities, translating quantitative output into committee-ready narratives.

sections.heading: Process & Technology Improvement
bullets: Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls.

Deployed agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection, cutting development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

Onboarded U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms onto PFaroe DB (risk & ALM analytics) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management), validating model outputs post-deployment and translating investment-team requirements into development requests.
Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Coordinated across actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management teams on milestone delivery, contributing to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on Value at Risk (VaR) and Conditional VaR (CVaR) using Ortec's GLASS platform, testing allocation robustness across near-optimal frontier portfolios.
Executed risk decomposition and attribution (contribution-to-risk, risk budgeting) to isolate the drivers of portfolio and funding-ratio volatility.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed macroeconomic environments.
Conducted cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk for international institutional clients.
Advised clients on strategic and tactical asset allocation trade-offs through stress testing and sensitivity analysis, presenting findings to pension-fund investment committees on-site.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
